note: Curated advisory records for the vendors typically found on an ERP + OT network (Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Schneider Electric). Every record carries the source URL it was taken from and the date it was checked. Use `otscope advisories update` to pull the CISA KEV catalog for exploit-intelligence enrichment, and add your own records in `local.json` next to this file - they are merged at load time.

advisories.title: Denial of service over ISO-TSAP (102/tcp)
advisories.attack: Specially crafted packets sent to port 102/tcp (ISO-TSAP) or via Profibus put the CPU into defect mode.
advisories.impact: Denial of service; a cold restart is required to recover the system.
advisories.remediation: Update the CPU firmware to V3.2.12 / V3.3.12, apply protection level 3 (read/write protection) and restrict 102/tcp to known engineering and HMI stations.

advisories.product: SIMATIC S7 / ET 200 / SINAMICS / SINUMERIK (SNMP stack)
advisories.title: SNMP denial of service (161/udp)
advisories.attack: Specially crafted packets sent to port 161/udp cause a denial-of-service condition; affected devices must be restarted manually.
advisories.impact: Denial of service requiring a manual restart of the device.
advisories.remediation: Disable SNMP on the device if the product supports it (this fully mitigates the issue), or protect access to 161/udp with an ACL. Siemens recommends the cell protection concept.

advisories.product: SIMATIC S7-300 / S7-400 H / S7-1500 and PROFINET IO
advisories.title: Improper input validation causing denial of service
advisories.attack: Exploitable from an adjacent network; improper input validation leads to a denial-of-service condition.
advisories.impact: Denial of service requiring a manual restart to recover the system.
advisories.remediation: Update S7-300 to V3.x.16; for the other families apply the cell protection concept and restrict adjacent-network access.

affected.range: PN/DP V6 and below, all versions

advisories.title: Web server resource exhaustion (80/443)
advisories.attack: Specially crafted HTTP requests to ports 80/tcp and 443/tcp exhaust resources on the embedded web server.
advisories.impact: Denial of service of the device web server.
advisories.remediation: Update S7-300 PN/DP to V3.x.17 and S7-1200 to V4.1; otherwise disable the CPU web server in the hardware configuration.

advisories.product: SIMATIC S7-300 CPUs and SINUMERIK controllers over PROFINET
advisories.title: Uncontrolled resource consumption over PROFINET
advisories.attack: Uncontrolled resource consumption causes the affected device to go into defect mode.
advisories.impact: Denial-of-service condition; the device must be restarted.
advisories.remediation: Update the S7-300 CPU family to V3.x.17 or later and apply the cell protection concept.

affected.fixed: V3.1.0 for the listed CPU types

advisories.title: Use-after-free on 102/tcp
advisories.attack: Affected devices improperly handle specially crafted packets sent to port 102/tcp.
advisories.impact: Denial of service; a restart is needed to restore normal operation.
advisories.remediation: Update the affected CPU types to V3.1.0 or later; restrict 102/tcp to trusted peers.

advisories.title: Stack-based buffer overflow, hard-coded credentials, weak cryptography
advisories.attack: Stack-based buffer overflow, use of hard-coded credentials and a broken cryptographic algorithm in the Modicon controllers and the BMXNOR0200H module.
advisories.impact: Remote code execution and credential compromise on the controller, including over the FTP service.
advisories.remediation: Disable FTP on the device when configuration/maintenance is not in progress, follow the Modicon Controllers Platform Cyber Security reference manual, and segment 502/tcp.

affected.fixed: no fix at time of publication

advisories.title: Use of insufficiently random values
advisories.attack: Use of insufficiently random values in the controller; exploitable from an adjacent network with low skill.
advisories.impact: Information disclosure and integrity impact on the controller session.
advisories.remediation: Update M580 to firmware V2.80; for M340 apply network segmentation and firewall rules blocking remote access to the TCP ports, and configure the module access control list.
advisories.lifecycle_note: Schneider Electric reported in December 2018 that the Modicon Premium and Quantum controllers reached the End of Commercialization life cycle.

advisories.title: Uncaught exception on Modbus memory block read
advisories.attack: An uncaught exception occurs when reading memory blocks with an invalid data size or an invalid data offset over Modbus.
advisories.impact: Denial of service of the controller.
advisories.remediation: Update EcoStruxure Control Expert to V16.0 or later and the M340/Quantum firmware to SV3.60; set an application password, segment the network and block unauthorised access to 502/tcp; configure the module access control list.

advisories.product: Modicon M340, BMXNOE0100 and BMXNOE0110 modules
advisories.title: Files or directories accessible to external parties
advisories.attack: Attackers can remove specific files or directories from the filesystem through the exposed web server.
advisories.impact: Prevents firmware updates and disrupts the web server behaviour.
advisories.remediation: Update BMXNOE0100 to SV3.60 and BMXNOE0110 to SV6.80 (a reboot is required); minimise network exposure of control system devices.

advisories.title: Insufficiently protected credentials (controller verification key)
advisories.attack: Studio 5000 Logix Designer (V21+) and RSLogix 5000 (V16-20) use a key to verify that Logix controllers are communicating with genuine Rockwell software; the key is insufficiently protected.
advisories.impact: An unauthenticated remote attacker can impersonate the engineering software and read from / write to the controller - full loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.
advisories.remediation: Apply the Rockwell mitigations from the advisory, enable the Controller Log (V17+) or Change Detection (V20+), and restrict 44818/tcp to the engineering workstation only.

advisories.title: Heap-based buffer overflow and improper input validation
advisories.attack: A heap overflow allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to send malicious port ranges; improper input validation allows other malformed requests. CVE-2020-27251 scores 9.8, CVE-2020-27253 scores 8.6.
advisories.impact: Remote code execution on the host running FactoryTalk Linx - typically the SCADA/historian server that bridges ERP and OT.
advisories.remediation: Update FactoryTalk Linx to V6.20 or later (patch answer ID 1126433 for V6.10/6.11).

advisories.product: FactoryTalk Linx and FactoryTalk Services Platform
advisories.title: Classic buffer overflow and improper handling of exceptional conditions
advisories.attack: Classic buffer overflow and improper check/handling of exceptional conditions in the data communications platform.
advisories.impact: Denial of service of the communications platform between ERP and the controllers.
advisories.remediation: Update FactoryTalk Linx / FactoryTalk Services Platform beyond V6.20 per the vendor advisory.

advisories.title: Privilege chaining
advisories.attack: Privilege chaining (CWE-268) in FactoryTalk Linx versions 6.40 and prior.
advisories.impact: Local privilege escalation on the host running FactoryTalk Linx.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to V6.50 or later and install the Microsoft patch addressing the MSI issue.
